title: One budgeted lane packet ranked by match and effect replaces the unbudgeted briefStandards block
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114e (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-plan-1114e.md) slice 7: lane brief has two uncoordinated blocks; briefStandards (src/brain/standards.ts:590) unbudgeted, never measured.
Outcome: one 600-token packet ranked by match x effect; command-enforced records omitted (the check teaches them).
Proof: FR-40 lanes rerun (about $10, paid): B-A >= +15 pp kept.
Research 1114g: persistent task-sliced memory (arXiv 2609.00006) and on-demand pull (SWE-MeM, arXiv 2606.28434): consider a worker-callable 'krn standards query' beside the pushed packet.
